'''Loodux''' was an insane [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Nuukol]] hired Loodux to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tsillog]] outside the [[Quarren embassy]]. However, Loodux's assassination attempt failed and he was defeated by a group of agents.

==Skills and abilities==
He was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarren]], and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]].<ref name="GoI" />
